create_VolumeFusion: create a VolumeFusion instance with voxel size, extent, and device to initialize a global 3D volume for occupancy fusion
run_VolumeFusion_fuse: run the fuse method on a VolumeFusion object to integrate a local occupancy volume into the global volume using a pose transform
get_VolumeFusion_trimesh: get a trimesh mesh from a VolumeFusion object by extracting an isosurface via marching cubes on the fused global volume
create_VolumetricFusion: create a VolumetricFusion instance from an input folder containing per-snippet occupancy predictions and camera poses to prepare batch fusion
run_VolumetricFusion_run: run the VolumetricFusion run method to fuse all per-snippet occupancy predictions into a single global 3D volume and extract a mesh
